title: SarnautCore loot table
description: A loot table: one tree with exactly one root node, made of and / or / single-item / money nodes. Loot tables are global resources under /World/LootTables and carry no zone. Evaluation semantics are specified in docs/specs/mechanics/loot.md; this schema fixes the authored shape only.

chance.description: A probability. Its meaning depends on the parent node: independent per-entry probability under an and node, a distribution weight under an or node (loot.md rules 5.3 and 5.4).

container.description: A node with children. entries and chances are positionally paired and MUST be the same length; JSON Schema cannot express that cross-array constraint, so scripts/check_references.py enforces it and the loader re-checks it at load time (loot.md section 4).

singleItem.description: A leaf granting one item in a count drawn from [min_number, max_number].

money.description: A leaf crediting the purse. It carries no item reference (loot.md rule 5.6.1).

node.description: Any loot node. Branches are discriminated by the required node discriminator (and/or, single-item, money), so at most one can ever match. max_number >= min_number is not expressible here and is enforced by scripts/check_references.py and at load time.
